summary: fix(settings): report actionable Glean reasons for passkey errors
description:
Because:
- Passkey error metrics couldn't separate failures we can fix from ones we can't.
- Add-passkey kept its own reason map, reporting webauthn_unknown and auth_error_<n>.
- Sentry received device and network errors that no engineering fix addresses.

This commit:
- Makes add-passkey report the shared WebAuthn gleanReason, plus network_error.
- Names server refusals 226, 233, 114, 125 and 238; the rest report server_error.
- Adds not_readable, and reports every duplicate passkey as not_allowed.
- Stops sending network, device and duplicate-passkey errors to Sentry.
- Makes sign-in choose its banner from errorType, not gleanReason.

Closes #FXA-14005
